LESSON: NEWS TELLING

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP2
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.1: News telling
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 5

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers News telling, part of Strand 1 in SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP2 General.

Key inquiry question: what they did before coming to school and what they will do after school. 1. What do we do before coming to school?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. tell news on daily happenings with ease,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of News telling in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. narrate events as they happen in a sequence to communicate order and time,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of News telling in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. actively contribute in activities on news telling. ● Watch a video clip indicating activities done at different times of the day. Light intensity could be adjusted for learner who are sensitive to light. ● Observe and talk about pictures showing activities done at different times of the day. Learners with speech difficulties could use alternative modes of communication to express their views. ● Talk about different activities we do every day from morning to evening: waking up, taking breakfast, preparing for school, going to school, break time, lunch, evening, sleepin

   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

G. . ● Narrate in pairs the day’s happenings, like what they did before coming to school and what they will do after school. 1. What do we do before coming to school? 2. SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on News telling together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
• Integrity: The learner demonstrates self-discipline through talking about different activities we do every day from morning

to evening for this will help do the right thing at the right time.

• Respect: The learner practices patience and takes turns with others when narrating the day’s happenings.

Core competencies:

• Communication and collaboration: The learner audibly and correctly articulates words in sentences while talking about

different activities we do every day from morning to evening.

• Self-efficacy: The learner with confidence narrates the day’s happenings, like what they did before coming to school and

what they will do after school.

• Critical thinking and problem solving: The learner recalls and narrates the order or routine of daily activities.

Values:

• Integrity: The learner demonstrates self-discipline through talking about different activities we do every day from morning

to evening for this will help do the right thing at the right time.

• Respect: The learner practices patience and takes turns with others when narrating the day’s happenings.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issue(
s) :

Interpersonal relationship: The learner maintains a positive relationship with the others as they narrate to each other the day’s

happenings thus maintaining order.

Link to other Activity Areas:

Telling news about time links to measurement of time in Mathematics Activities where the learner measures time through

daily routine.
